candidates.name: Things 3
candidates.verdict: PICK: best personal to-do UX but Apple-only

candidates.name: TickTick
candidates.verdict: Good value, no official MCP found

candidates.name: Sunsama / Akiflow / Motion
candidates.verdict: Paid planners, no real free tier

decision: Todoist is the best personal task manager for a general founder: every platform, natural-language capture, an API and an official AI/MCP integration. Things 3 is the better-designed app if every device is Apple and a one-time price appeals. Keep product work in the backlog tracker and personal admin here.
details: Things price is set per country in the App Store; not captured.

os_notes.macOS: Todoist, or Things 3 (Mac $49.99 one-time in the US App Store; iPhone/iPad apps sold separately).
os_notes.Windows: Todoist or Super Productivity; Things is unavailable.
os_notes.Linux: Todoist desktop app or web; Super Productivity (Flathub/Snap).

verify.note: If the editor keeps Things, at minimum fix pick.free_limits to 'Mac $49.99 one-time (US App Store); iPhone/iPad sold separately; free Mac trial', pick.maintained 'v3.24.1 (Sep 30)' and pick.platforms 'macOS|iOS|iPadOS|watchOS|visionOS'.
